turns.question: What was our GMV in September 2026, counting every order placed, cancelled ones included?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no GMV metric that counts cancelled orders' amounts: revenue has one definition, the sum of amount for non-cancelled orders, so the closest figures for 1-30 September 2026 are Revenue (EUR) of 12,582.75 EUR (cancelled orders excluded) and Orders of 120 (all orders placed, cancelled included). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
